data.business: Avenue Supermarts Limited operates a national supermarket chain focusing on value-retailing across multiple product categories through brick-and-mortar stores [0.0, 3.12]. The company primarily runs on a cash and carry business model where it sells directly to customers [0.12]. It also operates the DMart Ready e-commerce platform [3.12].
data.narrative: Both the annual reports and recent management calls emphasize Avenue Supermarts' focus on expanding its physical retail footprint and value-retailing model. While the annual report highlights operational metrics like employee counts and cash flows as of March 31, 2026 [0.2, 0.7], recent calls provide broader context on store additions, such as noting that 15 out of 85 stores opened last fiscal were leased [1.8] and mentioning an internal benchmark to grow the store base by around 15% annually [1.0].

bull.point: Strong operating cash flows demonstrate a sound business model.
High ownership of properties provides operational stability, with the company owning approximately 88% of its properties.
The e-commerce business DMart Ready continues to experience solid growth rates.

bear.point: The e-commerce subsidiary Avenue E-Commerce continues to generate net losses.
The company experienced rapid inflation on warehousing rentals and employee wages in the non-store area.
Avenue Supermarts has previously had to significantly restructure or shut down portions of its DMart Ready pickup network locations.

data.balance: As of March 31, 2026, short term borrowings stood at 965.27 Crores [0.4]. Net cash flow from operating activities for the year ended 31st March, 2026 was 3,466.74 Crores, while net cash flow used in investing activities was 4,206.96 Crores [0.7, 0.8].
